components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: Persistent tactile light/dark control with a mechanical click on direct activation.
components.html: <button class="ds-theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Switch theme"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-theme-toggle svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { color: #f45b26; transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f45b26; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Back Link
components.description: Compact directional navigation over project and secondary-page surfaces.
components.html: INDEX
components.css: .ds-back-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f2f2ef; color: #111111; font: 500 0.95rem/1.6 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-back-link svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-right: 8px; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-back-link:hover, .ds-back-link:focus-visible { color: #f45b26; } .ds-back-link:hover svg, .ds-back-link:focus-visible svg { transform: translateX(-4px); } .ds-back-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f45b26; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Index Row
components.description: The primary portfolio navigation pattern: work title paired with a tabular date.
components.html: App Builder in M365 CopilotSEP 2025 —
components.css: .ds-index-row { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; padding: 20px 0; border-top: 1px solid #d8d8d6; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-index-row::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 25%; bottom: 25%; width: 3px; background: #f45b26; transform: scaleY(0); transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-index-row:hover::before, .ds-index-row:focus-visible::before { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-index-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f45b26; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-index-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-index-meta { color: #595959; font-size: 0.85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Gallery Container

narrative.overview: The portfolio behaves like a well-made personal instrument: immediately legible, materially quiet, and rewarding under closer inspection. Its Braun influence comes from usefulness, proportion, typography, honest structure, and disciplined restraint—not from nostalgic imitation. Personality arrives through a few tactile signatures that remain optional and never outrank the work.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained neutral surfaces with one sparing orange signal
Single-family typography with decisive size and weight contrast
Narrow, centered reading measures and ruled index structures
Flat surfaces with light structural borders and rare ambient shadows
Tactile, personal details that remain optional and non-blocking
Responsive simplification without loss of meaning

rules.name: The Evidence-First Rule
rules.body: Personality may delight; project visuals must inform. No decorative treatment may substitute for authentic work, decisions, or outcomes.

rules.name: The Quiet-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Pages remain visually still and legible by default. Motion responds to navigation, interaction, location, or discovery; reduced-motion users receive an equivalent static state.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange occupies less than 10% of a page and marks action, state, location, or a deliberate signature. Never use it as general body text on Instrument White.

rules.name: The Two-Housing Rule
rules.body: Light and dark themes are equal instrument housings, not separate brands. Preserve role parity when adding a token.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not add a display serif, geometric companion, or decorative mono to manufacture character.

rules.name: The Label Rationing Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is reserved for compact metadata and true index labels. Never place an eyebrow above every heading.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a static surface needs a shadow to appear organized, its spacing, border, or tonal relationship is wrong.

rules.name: The Ambient Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows remain broad, quiet, and below 10% black opacity at rest. Hard shadows and stacked card elevation are prohibited.

dos: Do let structure, proportion, typography, and authentic project evidence carry the identity.
Do preserve the cycling San Francisco icons as an expression of place and provide a static reduced-motion state.
Do preserve the user-triggered mechanical theme sound and blueprint easter egg as optional signatures.
Do use Signal Orange only for action, state, location, or a deliberate motif.
Do keep body text within a focused 65–75 character reading measure.
Do keep every primary action and all content understandable without hover, sound, animation, or discovery of an easter egg.
Do use authentic screenshots, redacted artifacts, diagrams, and captions when presenting project work.
donts: Don't add ornamental industrial-design motifs that do not explain the work.
Don't fall into generic portfolio templates.
Don't use decorative technical diagrams as substitutes for authentic evidence.
Don't add any treatment that makes the work harder to understand.
Don't confuse aesthetic cosplay with functional clarity.
Don't autoplay sound or require motion to understand a state change.
